meta.source_event: v54 final update notes - five document pack

findings.title: Joomla JCE Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution
findings.description: Joomla Content Editor upload path allows unauthenticated remote code execution in vulnerable JCE versions. NACSA/KEV brief marks this as P0 with public exploit availability.
findings.recommended_action: Upgrade JCE to 2.9.99.6 or later, block PHP execution in upload/tmp paths, and add WAF filtering for the exploit endpoint.
findings.mas_trm_mapping: MAS TRM Section 9 - Application security patching

findings.title: Microsoft SharePoint Server RCE - Deserialization
findings.description: Authenticated SharePoint Site Member can trigger remote code execution through deserialization of untrusted data. CISA KEV added 2026-07-01; federal deadline 2026-07-04 is overdue.
findings.recommended_action: Apply the May 2026 SharePoint security update and review Storm-2603/Warlock indicators.

findings.title: SimpleHelp OIDC Authentication Bypass
findings.description: SimpleHelp OIDC bypass confirmed as a KEV-gap item requiring exposure triage for remote support infrastructure.
findings.recommended_action: Patch SimpleHelp, restrict remote support portals, and review authentication logs.

findings.title: PTC Windchill/FlexPLM Exposure
findings.description: PTC Windchill/FlexPLM KEV-gap item from the v52 notes. Treat exposed PLM systems as third-party/product data exposure.
findings.recommended_action: Patch affected PTC systems and remove management/API surfaces from direct internet exposure.

findings.title: Cisco Unified CM SSRF
findings.description: Cisco Unified Communications Manager server-side request forgery item from the v52 KEV-gap list.
findings.recommended_action: Patch Cisco Unified CM and restrict administrative interfaces to management networks.

findings.title: Citrix NetScaler SAML IDP Memory Overread
findings.description: Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway July 2026 batch item. Credential-adjacent memory overread raises TES above base CVSS.
findings.recommended_action: Patch NetScaler ADC/Gateway to 14.1-72.61+ or 13.1-63.18+.

findings.title: Citrix NetScaler Gateway/AAA DoS
findings.description: Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway July 2026 DoS batch item affecting Gateway/AAA availability.
findings.recommended_action: Patch NetScaler ADC/Gateway and review Gateway/AAA exposure.

findings.title: Citrix NetScaler DNS/LB DoS
findings.description: Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway July 2026 DoS batch item affecting DNS/load-balancing stability.
findings.recommended_action: Patch NetScaler ADC/Gateway.

findings.title: Citrix NetScaler Unauthenticated File Read
findings.description: Unauthenticated arbitrary file read if NetScaler management interfaces are exposed to the internet. Downgrade only when NSIP/SNIP management is not internet-facing.
findings.recommended_action: Patch NetScaler and remove NSIP/SNIP management interfaces from internet exposure.

findings.title: Citrix NetScaler TCP Timestamp Overread
findings.description: Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway July 2026 memory overread item with lower exploit likelihood.
findings.recommended_action: Patch NetScaler ADC/Gateway during the next urgent maintenance window.

findings.title: Citrix NetScaler HTTP/2 DoS Requires Config Fix
findings.description: Citrix NetScaler HTTP/2 DoS item where patching alone is insufficient unless HTTP Strict Profiles are used.
findings.recommended_action: Patch NetScaler and set Http2SmallWndTimeout=30 if not using HTTP Strict Profiles.
compensating_controls: Set Http2SmallWndTimeout=30 when HTTP Strict Profiles are not used

findings.title: RustDuck Botnet Multi-CVE Router and Server Chain
findings.description: RustDuck targets weak/default Telnet/SSH, exposed ADB, IoT devices, routers, cameras, and exposed servers using a multi-CVE chain with no single patch path.
findings.recommended_action: COMPENSATING_CONTROL
compensating_controls: Replace EoL Huawei HG532 and D-Link DIR-823X devices

findings.title: Endpoint Secret Exposure in MCP Configs and AI Agent Logs
findings.description: Developer endpoints hold credentials in .env files, shell history, cloud profiles, MCP configs, and AI agent logs. Repo-only secret scanning misses this surface.
findings.affected_ecosystem: Developer endpoints / MCP / AI agent logs
findings.recommended_action: COMPENSATING_CONTROL
compensating_controls: Scan endpoints with explicit client consent
Treat MCP configs and agent logs as secret-bearing files

findings.title: Business Flow Bypass
findings.description: Application workflow can be advanced or skipped out of order, bypassing intended approval or payment gates without a CVE.
findings.recommended_action: Enforce server-side state transitions and add negative workflow tests.

findings.title: Tenant Boundary Authorization Failure
findings.description: Authenticated user can cross tenant or role boundaries through valid-looking requests. Traditional DAST may see HTTP 200 and miss ownership semantics.
findings.recommended_action: Enforce tenant scoping in every object query and add cross-tenant regression tests.

findings.title: EchoLeak-Class Agentic Authority Compromise
findings.description: AI agent with standing credentials processes untrusted content as instruction. No single patch separates data from instructions for agentic workflows.
findings.recommended_action: COMPENSATING_CONTROL

findings.title: NHI Triage Agent Authority Exposure
findings.description: Issue triage agent reads untrusted Jira/Linear content while holding ticketing API tokens.
findings.recommended_action: COMPENSATING_CONTROL
compensating_controls: Sanitize issue text before agent ingestion

findings.title: NHI Implementation Agent Repo Write Exposure
findings.description: Code implementation agent reads untrusted task context while holding repository write credentials or SSH keys.
findings.recommended_action: COMPENSATING_CONTROL
compensating_controls: Block standing production secrets in agent runtime

findings.title: NHI Review Agent Merge Authority Exposure
findings.description: Automated review agent can be steered by malicious PR comments while holding comment, approval, or merge-related authority.
findings.recommended_action: COMPENSATING_CONTROL
compensating_controls: Separate review comments from privileged instructions

findings.title: NHI Deployment Agent Production Authority Exposure
findings.description: CI/CD deployment agent processes untrusted context while holding production deploy or cloud credentials.
findings.recommended_action: COMPENSATING_CONTROL

findings.title: NHI Monitoring Agent Read Authority Exposure
findings.description: Monitoring agent reads untrusted alerts/log content while holding Datadog, PagerDuty, or log-read credentials.
findings.recommended_action: COMPENSATING_CONTROL
compensating_controls: Separate alert content from agent instructions
